newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Tribune buy reiterated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Tribune buy reiterated.

text.p: -- Prudential Securities Inc on Friday reiterated its buy recommendation on Tribune Co's stock after the media company reported fourth-quarter results in line with expectations.
-- Analyst Melissa Cook said her 12-month price target on the stock was $47.50.
-- Cook pointed out that Tribune shares were trading at 7.3 times estimated 1997 EBITDA, on the low end of market ranges for newspaper-only companies.

-- "Since broadcasting, which typically sells two-to-three or more multiple points richer than newspapers, is slated to generate nearly half of Tribune's cash flow in 1997 after the closing of the Renaissance acquisition, we believe this is an inappropriately low valuation for the Tribune shares," she wrote in a report.
-- Tribune shares were off 1/2 at 36-5/8 in early afternoon trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
